training.cache_fraction: benchmark selected; recorded in runtime plan.json
training.selection: minimum validation MSE; earliest exact tie
training.initialization: same original A0 common initial parameters; new ssai_local parameters created after the original network; no warm start

operation.changed_location: per-band SSA computation at full, half and quarter resolution; original SSA modules kept registered but unused
operation.unchanged: backbone, conv48tnum fusion (16->4), PReLU, decoder, loss, data
operation.normalization: softmax over valid 7x7 neighbours (out-of-image masked); no global spatial softmax, area factor or gamma
operation.L2_key: per-stage 1x1 64->16 on backbone features, bilinear 0.5 per stage like res
operation.L1_key: per-stage 1x1 16->16 on the PAN encoder output
operation.C_control: per band: 1x1 (5+16+16 -> 10), ReLU, depthwise 7x7, 1x1 10->4; same inputs as L2, parameter-matched, no attention
operation.position_bias: per stage, band and head, 49 offsets, zero initial

diagnostics.D1: A0 best with original SSA outputs zeroed: validation (prepare) and RR20/FR20 (evaluation arm A0Z)
diagnostics.D2: stage operator interior equality between 96x96 input and 64x64 crop, float64 CPU

success_goal.rr: PSNR >= +0.2 dB and SAM <= -0.1 deg vs A0, ERGAS improves
success_goal.fr: provisional QNR >= A0; D_s deterioration above 0.005 is at most partial improvement
success_goal.attribution: attention effect only when L2 beats C on RR and FR
success_goal.promotion: never automatic; seed43/44 repeats are proposals only
